title: atljamaica.com
description: Sandals Resorts International (SRI) is a Jamaican luxury resort chain operating under the all-inclusive brand across the Caribbean. Appliance Traders Limited (ATL) is a retail electronics chain operating under the ATL Jamaica brand. Both companies belong to the same corporate structure: "ATL Group of Companies" and "Sandals Group of Companies" are used interchangeably in their internal documents to refer to the same circle of affiliated entities.
